name: T-Eval
description: T-Eval is a benchmark designed to evaluate the tool utilization capability of large language models by decomposing the evaluation into multiple sub-processes such as instruction following, planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, and review. It provides a fine-grained analysis of LLMs' tool-utilization abilities beyond holistic evaluation.
reputation: A recent benchmark for tool-use evaluation that has gained attention in the LLM agent/tool-calling community for its fine-grained decomposition of tool utilization skills.
notes: Benchmark disentangles tool utilization evaluation into sub-domains for detailed capability analysis; benchmark will be available at https://github.com/open-compass/T-Eval.
